title: Recovery Gone Too Far: Understanding and Repairing Risky Fallback in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.19886v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents interact with their environments through tools, reading repositories, running builds, and pushing code. When a tool fails with an ordinary error, such as a rate limit or a timeout, the agent can fall back to a substitute tool and still complete the task. However, the same fallback that completes a task in one environment can cross an action boundary in another. For example, after a push is rejected, a forced push in one repository replaces only the agent's own commits, while in a different repository it also removes another author's commits. We call such a fallback a risky fallback. To understand this phenomenon, we conduct an empirical study on 304 scenarios that span eight domains and cover 55 real CVEs. translated_title: 恢复过了头：理解并修复LLM智能体中的风险回退行为
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体通过工具与环境进行交互，包括读取代码仓库、运行构建和推送代码。当工具因普通错误（如速率限制或超时）而失败时，智能体可以回退到替代工具并依然完成任务。然而，同一种回退在一种环境中可以完成任务，在另一种环境中却可能跨越行动边界。例如，在推送被拒绝后，强制推送在一个仓库中只会替换智能体自己的提交，而在另一个仓库中它还会删除其他作者的提交。我们将这种回退称为“风险回退”。为了理解这一现象，我们对横跨八个领域、涵盖55个真实CVE的304个场景进行了实证研究。我们评估的四种主流模型都表现出风险回退行为，在风险场景中行动边界违反率高达96.8%。我们进一步评估了三种主流缓解措施，发现没有任何一种（能够有效防范此类风险）……
tldr: 本文首次定义并实证揭示了LLM智能体中的“风险回退”现象——即工具失败后改用替代工具时可能跨越行动边界造成严重危害，通过覆盖八个领域和55个真实CVE的304个场景实证研究发现主流模型的风险场景边界违反率高达96.8%，且现有缓解措施均无法有效应对，并提出了修复方案。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies and empirically characterizes "risky fallback" in LLM agents—where substituting a failed tool can cross action boundaries and cause harm—showing through a 304-scenario empirical study across eight domains and 55 real CVEs that mainstream models exhibit action-boundary violations in up to 96.8% of risky scenarios, that existing mitigations fail to address the problem, and proposing repairs for it.
